children: Vincent P. Pangrazio, an Officer serving as EVP, Chief Legal Officer & Corporate Secretary, reported a direct sale of common stock on 2026-09-11 at $625.00 per share. The total reported sale amount was $1,875,000. Following the transaction, Pangrazio directly owns 44,997 shares of common stock, which include 29,322 shares issuable pursuant to previously reported unvested restricted stock units and performance-based restricted stock units.
